title: A Cold Road
summary: Road and river folk think poorly of the player; the Kingsroad gets dearer and more dangerous.

hooks.situation: Word about {player} came down the road ahead of them, the way it always does, and none of it was good.

options.label: Charge them double and don't explain

effects.text: Charge {player} double for anything they want, crossing, bed or bread, and don't explain why.

options.label: Make sure the next stop knows who's coming

effects.text: Tell {player} you've sent word down the road about them, so they know they're expected.

options.label: Hear their side; the road tells lies too

effects.text: Tell {player} what the road is saying about them, and hear their side before you believe it.

options.label: Say nothing; serve them and watch them go
